/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
work_tmp=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:?}/bkp-bing.XXXXXX")
queries=(
  '"'\"B.K.P. College of Computer Education\" Deori Madhya Pradesh official'
  '\"BKP College of Computer Education\" Deori official website'
  '\"B.K.P. College\" Deori computer education'
  '\"B.K.P. College of Computer Education\" courses'
)
i=0
for q in \""'${queries[@]}"; do
  i=$((i+1))
  enc=$(printf '"'%s' \""'$q" | jq -sRr @uri)
  out="$work_tmp/search_$i.html"
  curl --insecure --fail --silent --show-error --location --max-time 30 -A '"'Mozilla/5.0' \"https://www.bing.com/search?q="'$enc&count=10" -o "$out" || true
  printf '"'\\n-- QUERY %d: %s --\\n' \""'$i" "$q"
  sed -e '"'s/<["'^>]*>/'"\\n/g' -e 's/&/\\&/g' -e 's/'/'\"'\"'/g' -e 's/"/\"/g' \""'$out" | tr -s '"'[:space:]' ' ' | fold -w 180 | sed -n '1,25p'
done
printf '\\nTEMP=%s\\n' \""'$work_tmp"'
